title: Define structured docs data layer contract
summary: Freeze docs-data layout, record schema, relation schema, and render contract.
requirement: Define the canonical docs-data layout, stable document/task/relation schema, and generated docs contract.

title: Add mandatory document task tools
summary: Extend the structured docs tool surface and connect doc task mutations to the canonical source.
requirement: Provide mandatory structured docs tool actions for doc task, doc record, relation, render, validate, and extraction workflows.
acceptance: tool path no longer depends on direct markdown edits

title: Implement docs renderer and generated layer
summary: Render deterministic markdown from docs-data into the existing docs tree.
requirement: Generate stable docs presentation files from docs-data records without reintroducing markdown as the primary source.
acceptance: generated docs stay in current layout

title: Add parity validator and extraction tooling
summary: Support extraction of current markdown into docs-data and validate generated output against the canonical source.
requirement: Provide extraction and validation tooling so docs migration can be proven and repeated safely.
acceptance: relative and repo-root links validate correctly

title: Migrate document-related .claude skills
summary: Move document skills to structured docs v2 so they default to doc task/doc record, render, and validate workflows.
requirement: Update docs-general, docs-guide, docs-prds, docs-specs, docs-todo, and docs-logs to treat docs-data as canonical and docs markdown as generated presentation.
acceptance: document-related skills mention docs-data as canonical source
skills forbid direct markdown as the default write path
skills require render and validate after structured edits

title: Migrate current docs and complete cutover
summary: Extract the existing docs tree into docs-data, regenerate docs, and complete the structured docs v2 cutover.
requirement: Migrate the current docs presentation into docs-data, rerender the docs tree, and validate the resulting cutover so docs-data becomes the canonical source.
acceptance: docs tree is extracted into docs-data
cutover runner validates the migrated docs set

title: Plan repository-external structured docs CLI
summary: Define a standalone structured docs CLI that runs outside Omega session runtime and reuses the omega-document backend.
requirement: Provide a stable repository-external CLI plan for render, validate, extract, cutover, and doctor workflows against arbitrary --root targets.
acceptance: external CLI command surface is specified
output, exit code, and validation expectations are documented

title: Plan docs-data-backed /plan convergence
summary: Document the follow-up that moves /plan canonical persistence from .omega/plans into docs-data.
requirement: Define the docs-data-backed planning direction, rollout tasks, and spec/TODO linkage for converging project plan and structured docs storage.
acceptance: project-plan and structured-docs specs reference the follow-up

title: Add docs CLI mutation and query surface plan
summary: Extend omega-document-cli planning beyond render/validate into controlled mutations and id-based lookup.
requirement: Define CLI commands and contracts for stable-id get/list and controlled record/task/relation/archive/remove mutations.

title: Plan CLI-first docs guidance enforcement
summary: Define how skills and AGENTS.md guide Copilot/agents toward the omega-document-cli workflow.
requirement: Document CLI-first docs guidance for mutation, direct-read allowances for inspection, and stable-id lookup guidance for precise queries.
acceptance: skills guidance distinguishes read from mutation

title: Design docs-data to docs version contract
summary: Define revision and generation metadata so generated docs can be traced back to a specific docs-data state.
requirement: Specify manifest, render-state, and generated-doc metadata that link docs-data revisions to generated docs revisions.

title: Plan CLI-only docs workflow cutover
summary: Complete the final docs workflow cutover so structured docs mutation defaults to omega-doc and direct markdown/docs-data edits are reserved for emergency projection repair.
requirement: Document and complete the workflow cutover that makes CLI mutation the default and relegates direct markdown/docs-data edits to emergency-only projection-repair exceptions.
acceptance: direct markdown/docs-data edits are limited to emergency projection repair
normal structured docs mutation defaults to omega-doc
render, validate, and doctor remain mandatory after emergency repair

title: Create plan task detail navigator spec
summary: Write the spec defining three-level navigator UX flow and /plan links and /plan view-file subcommand contracts.
requirement: Define UX flow, subcommand contracts, link item shape, security rules, and implementation scope for the plan task detail navigator.
acceptance: UX flow covers all three navigation levels

title: Implement /plan links subcommand
summary: Add /plan links <id> to omega-session emitting a second-level OperatorPickerRequest with design, implementation, doc, and log link items.
requirement: Implement links handler in execute_plan_command: build picker items from PlannedTask design_links, implementation_links, and recent log entries; emit StateMessage::ShowOverlay with OperatorPickerRequest; Ctrl-L back action navigates to /plan list.
acceptance: Ctrl-L back action is in secondary_actions

title: Update /plan list Enter to use links navigator
summary: Change the primary Enter action of the /plan list picker from OpenDetail to SubmitSlashCommand /plan links {id} with CloseOverlay behavior.
requirement: In build_plan_list_picker_request change primary_action.intent from OperatorPickerIntent::OpenDetail to SubmitSlashCommand with template '/plan links {id}' and overlay_behavior CloseOverlay.
acceptance: /plan list Enter emits /plan links {id} slash command
overlay closes before links picker opens
regression test updated to verify the new intent

title: Implement /plan view-file subcommand
summary: Add /plan view-file <path> to omega-session that reads a workspace-relative file and emits a DetailOverlay with its content.
requirement: Implement view-file handler: canonicalize path against workspace root (reject path traversal and symlinks escaping root), read file, apply basic Markdown stripping, emit StateMessage::ShowOverlay with OverlayTarget::Detail. Return error for missing files or traversal attempts.
acceptance: basic MD stripping is applied to content
file not found returns error response
path traversal attempt returns error response with no overlay

title: Add presentation_links cross-reference in links picker
summary: Extend /plan links to look up the matching StructuredDocTask by plan_task_id and include its presentation_links as doc-category items.
requirement: In build_plan_links_picker_request, load the StructuredDocTask whose plan_task_id matches the requested task id, then add its presentation_links as items with badges=[doc] in the picker.
acceptance: doc items appear in links picker when presentation_links exist
tasks without matching doc task show no doc items without error

title: Tests for plan task navigator flow
summary: Write regression tests covering /plan links, /plan view-file, the updated /plan list Enter action, path traversal rejection, and the full three-level navigation sequence.
acceptance: list action SubmitSlashCommand intent test passes
